label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value depends on user input (param from request.getParameter). The sanitize operation replace("\"", """) only escapes double quotes, leaving other XSS vectors (angle brackets, single quotes, event handlers) unmitigated. Attacker can bypass via payload like \'><script>alert(1)</script>\' which executes despite the limited escaping.

evidence.note: User input flows from request.getParameter to bar variable, then to HTML attribute with incomplete sanitization (only double quotes escaped)
